title: Voxelium
description: Voxelium expands survival with new materials, recipes, and the /fly command — adding creative freedom while staying in Survival mode.
body:
🧊 Voxelium

 Voxelium is a content-expansion mod that adds new materials, items, recipes, and gameplay utilities to enhance survival with a creative twist.

✨ Features

🧪 New Materials

Sulfur

Salt

Lemon

⚙️ New Recipes

Custom Gunpowder recipe

Cow Spawn Egg recipe

Additional crafting integrations using the new materials

🕊️ New Command

✈️ /fly Command (Experimental)
/fly allows players to enable flying in Survival mode without switching to Creative, offering more freedom for building and exploration.

⚠️ Experimental Feature
The /fly command is still under development and may contain minor bugs or edge cases in the current release.
Designed primarily for singleplayer and controlled multiplayer environments
Intended for building, testing, and exploration, not competitive gameplay
Does not modify core game files or bypass Minecraft’s permission system

🔧 Planned Improvements
Known issues related to flight behavior and edge cases will be addressed in:
VX2 – stability and behavior fixes
VX3 – refinement, balance, and quality-of-life improvements
Feedback and bug reports are welcome and will help improve future versions.
🚧 Development Status

⚠️ VoxelVariants is still in active development

Features may change

Balance and mechanics are subject to updates

Bugs and missing content are possible

Feedback, suggestions, and bug reports are welcome and will help shape the future of the mod.

🔧 Loader & Version

Forge

Minecraft 1.20.1
